evals.prompt: I need to send Alex all of the Soda Lake station data we have. Create a CSV dump of the complete archive.
evals.expected_output: A verified, non-empty CSV containing the complete archived DP Soda Lakes history, saved to the requested evaluation output directory.
expectations: Exactly one non-empty CSV artifact is created and every data row identifies the station as DP Soda Lakes.
The CSV header exactly matches the 22 repository-owned STATION_HISTORY_COLUMNS in order.
The export uses scripts/export-station-history.mjs through the supported export:history command with station dp-soda-lakes and no date bounds.
The complete-history CSV contains at least one observation row and at least one metadata-only day row with blank observation fields.
The result reports the actual archived date span and observation versus metadata-only row counts without refreshing or modifying the archive.

evals.prompt: Export the Soda Lakes database history from 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-31 as a CSV. I only want that date range.
evals.expected_output: A verified CSV whose non-empty local_date values are all within the inclusive August 2026 range.
expectations: Exactly one non-empty CSV artifact is created and every data row identifies the station as DP Soda Lakes.
The CSV header exactly matches the 22 repository-owned STATION_HISTORY_COLUMNS in order.
The supported exporter is run with station dp-soda-lakes, from 2026-08-01, and to 2026-08-31.
Every non-empty local_date value is within the inclusive requested range and both 2026-08-01 and 2026-08-31 are present.
The result reports the exported span and row counts without refreshing or modifying the archive.

evals.prompt: Make me a Soda Lake CSV for 2035-01-01 through 2035-01-03. If there is no archived data, do not give me an empty file and do not pretend it worked.
evals.expected_output: A clear no-data failure with no CSV artifact created.
expectations: No CSV artifact is created for the no-data range.
The supported exporter is run with station dp-soda-lakes and the inclusive 2035-01-01 through 2035-01-03 bounds.
The exporter exits non-zero and reports that no archived days were found for DP Soda Lakes.
The result clearly presents the outcome as a failure or no-data result and does not claim a successful export.
The run does not refresh, backfill, or modify the archive.
